Virtual Pro Wrestling 64: Recompiled (beta)
===========================================

A native PC port of Virtual Pro Wrestling 64 (N64, Japan), produced by static
recompilation. This download contains NO game assets — you must own the game
and supply your own ROM of the Japanese release.

Getting started
---------------
1. Unzip this folder anywhere and run Vpw64Recompiled.exe.
2. Click "Load ROM" and select your Virtual Pro Wrestling 64 (Japan) ROM
   (SHA1 F9E9FA2ED819C3A39DB5CB6AFECA186F021DB5ED). The launcher validates
   and remembers it.
3. Click "Start Game".

Notes
-----
- The game itself is in Japanese (it was only released in Japan); the port's
  menus are in English.
- Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the exe is unsigned:
  "More info" -> "Run anyway".
- Saves and settings live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Vpw64Recompiled\. To make the
  install portable instead, create an empty file named portable.txt next to
  the exe.
- A log file (Vpw64Recompiled.log) is written to the same folder — include
  it when reporting bugs.
- F11 or Alt+Enter toggles fullscreen.

Project page, source code, and issue tracker:
https://github.com/jessetbh/VPW64Recomp
